title: Baby Creeper  - Малыш Крипер
description: Baby Creeper is a modification that adds the ability to tame a baby Creeper
body:
![Baby Creeper 1.20.1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e6a1903410d0988d04a0e380b1d0d14b007e64d.png)
Baby Creeper - the modification adds the ability to tame a baby Creeper. A very cute and tabletop mod that may interest many players, but this mod does not have a crafting recipe. The mob will not spawn by itself. **You can only get a Creeper from a summoning egg.**

To tame the baby, use gunpowder. The pet responds to the commands "let's go" and "sit", and you can also use a tag on it.

**The mod is also suitable for playing on the server!**

**Mod Features:** Baby Creeper scares away ordinary creepers when tamed! If you feed the baby an enchanted golden apple, then a special charged effect will work, which will allow the creeper to protect the owner. If the owner of the creeper is attacked by someone, then the kid will reach the enemy and explode with the power of the charged creeper and then remain alive. The kid also knows how to dance to music and you can put on helmets and hats made of both vanilla and mods!
